Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [MetalGreymon] and [Cyberdramon] names.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [MetalGreymon] and [Cyberdramon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [MetalGreymon] and [Cyberdramon].")
Can I activate this card's "If [Cyberdramon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards" effect if it has another copy of this card in its digivolution cards?

Effect: The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [MetalGreymon] and [Cyberdramon].

[On Play][When Digivolving] You may place 1 Digimon card with [Blue Flare] in its traits from your hand, or from under your Tamers, under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. Then, return 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck. If [Cyberdramon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck.
Special Play Condition: When you would play this card, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each placed card reduces the play cost.
